user_story: As a user, I want to browse products on mobile devices using a burger menu, so that I can easily navigate through the product offerings. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The user can open the menu by clicking the button with id 'react-burger-menu-btn'. 2. The menu should display the link with data-test 'inventory-sidebar-link' for accessing all items. 3. The user can close the menu by clicking the button with id 'react-burger-cross-btn'. 4. The product links like 'item_0_title_link', 'item_1_title_link', etc., should be visible and accessible.
